about: Facade facts for the Canary Wharf towers of 100 m and over (registry cwb- ids), for texturing the 3D model. Each building lists which fields were measured from open (CC0/PDM/CC BY) photos, which were judged by looking at photos (including CC BY-SA and other reference-only images: facts, not pixels), and which are assumptions.

method.rectification: OpenCV LSD line segments inside a hand-chosen region of the facade; RANSAC vanishing points for near-vertical and near-horizontal segments; homography that sends the vanishing line to infinity and makes both directions axis-aligned (affine rectification). Orientation forced so the region keeps top and left.
method.metric_aspect: The affine result has an unknown aspect. A focal length (from the two vanishing points when plausible, else 0.722 x long side = 26 mm-equivalent phone lens) gives the plane orientation and a vertical/horizontal scale ratio; rect-*.jpg files are resampled with it. The ratio changed by less than 10% between 13 mm and 26 mm lenses for most photos.
method.periods: Mean absolute Sobel gradient per column and per row; autocorrelation peaks (FFT cross-check); the fundamental chosen by judgement after looking at the patch with period ticks.
method.metres: floor_m: height/floors (stated as assumed) unless a face width gives a scale; bay_m from OSM face width / bay count where the whole face is visible, else floor_m x bay_px / (floor_px x aspect). Where both exist they are compared in measurement.check.
method.colours: k-means (k=3) in Lab on the rectified patch; cluster roles (glass/frame/spandrel) assigned by judgement. Colours depend on light and sky reflection.

error.one_canada_square: bay count 19.9 vs 19.8 known (+0.5%); floor height +2 to +4% vs assumption
error.landmark_pinnacle: panel width two ways agree within 3%
error.hsbc: floor height -12% vs height/floors (which includes crown and plant)

cwb-0413.name: One Canada Square
cwb-0413.architect: César Pelli & Associates (with Adamson Associates, Frederick Gibberd Coombes)
cwb-0413.cladding: stainless steel with a linen finish; punched square windows (each with a central mullion) in a regular grid; re-entrant stepped corners
cwb-0413.crown: 40 m square-based stainless steel pyramid with an aircraft warning beacon at the apex
cwb-0413.setbacks: none on the shaft; stepped (notched) corners full height
cwb-0413.night_lighting: pyramid lit by programmable fluorescent tubes; office windows lit in a grid

measurement.check: 19.9 window bays measured across the west face against 19.8 known (3,960 windows / 50 floors / 4 faces): +0.5%. Bay 59.0 m / 19.9 = 2.97 m. Floor height from the metric aspect: 4.07 m (ocs-a) and 4.0 m (ocs-b) against an assumed 3.9 m ((235 - 40 m pyramid) / 50): +2 to +4%.
measurement.colour_note: k-means (overcast light): #bdc5c3 steel 52%, #6e7e78 glass with sky reflection 33%, #434f4b glass in shade 16%

footprint_obb_m.note: oriented bounding box of the OSM outline (ODbL); used only as a scale for bay widths

cwb-0577.name: Landmark Pinnacle
cwb-0577.height_note: Wikipedia gives 233 m and 76 storeys (75 habitable)
cwb-0577.cladding: full-height unitised glass curtain wall, dark blue-grey and highly reflective; narrow vertical panels about 0.95 m; dark recessed vertical slots on the corners and in the centre of the end faces with light metal edge bands
cwb-0577.crown: flat top with a glass balustrade around the sky garden on level 75; plant screened by glazing
cwb-0577.setbacks: none; slender rectangular slab with chamfered/slotted corners
cwb-0577.night_lighting: residential windows lit irregularly; red aviation lights on the roof (seen in other towers nearby, not confirmed here)

measurement.check: panel width 0.94 m from the face width (48.6 m OSM long side / 51.5 panels) and 0.97 m from the assumed floor height (233 / 75 = 3.11 m) and the metric aspect: agree within 3%. Measured floor height 3.02 m against 3.11 m assumed: -3%.

footprint_obb_m.note: oriented bounding box of the OSM outline (ODbL); used only as a scale for bay widths

cwb-0451.name: Newfoundland
cwb-0451.cladding: structural steel diagrid exoskeleton clad in light grey/white metal ("the diamond tower") over grey glazing with narrow panes (about 1.35 m) and dark spandrel panels; rounded corners on the long faces
cwb-0451.pattern: diagrid: diamonds about 3.5 across the narrow face; a crossing node every 8 to 9 floors (measured 1475 px / 173 px per floor in newf-diagrid)
cwb-0451.crown: diagrid runs to the roof and closes in a triangulated band; flat roof
cwb-0451.setbacks: none; plan tapers slightly towards the top (judged from the aerials)
cwb-0451.night_lighting: diagrid lit in changing colours during the Winter Lights festival (Bex Walton, Flickr 50871287957, not downloaded); otherwise residential windows

measurement.note: newf-diagrid is a black-and-white photo: geometry only, no colour. Floor height 3.79 m = 220 / 58 includes the crown and podium, so it is an upper bound.

footprint_obb_m.note: oriented bounding box of the OSM outline (ODbL); used only as a scale for bay widths

cwb-0715.name: Hampton Tower (South Quay Plaza 1)
cwb-0715.cladding: unitised curtain wall with triple glazing and stainless steel cladding (Yuanda); blue-grey glass with a dark horizontal louvre/vent band on each floor; faceted plan with deep black vertical slots dividing the faces; winter gardens
cwb-0715.crown: top floors fully flush-glazed (no louvre band); stepped faceted top in tiers
cwb-0715.setbacks: faces step back in tiers near the top (judged from Commons photo by Mortadella42)
cwb-0715.night_lighting: residential windows; no feature lighting seen

measurement.note: floor period measured (32 px, very clean) but no face width is visible to give a scale; bay not measured (panes too fine at this distance). Floor height 214.5 / 68 assumed.

footprint_obb_m.note: oriented bounding box of the OSM outline (ODbL); used only as a scale for bay widths

cwb-0590.name: One Park Drive
cwb-0590.cladding: cylindrical tower; three apartment types expressed as different window rhythms (deep loggias in an irregular checker pattern, bay windows, wide panoramic bands at the top); light grey/white frames and balcony edges, dark glass
cwb-0590.crown: flat top; the top floors (duplex penthouses, floors 55-57) have wider continuous glazing
cwb-0590.setbacks: none; the pattern changes with height instead (checkerboard loggias low, larger openings high)

measurement.note: a cylinder cannot be rectified by one homography; the patch is only valid in a narrow vertical strip. Diameter about 43 m (OSM). Floor height 205 / 57 assumed.

footprint_obb_m.note: oriented bounding box of the OSM outline (ODbL); used only as a scale for bay widths

cwb-0520.name: Citigroup Centre (25 Canada Square)
cwb-0520.cladding: blue-green glass curtain wall with projecting stainless steel vertical fins about every 5 m and finer mullions between (about 3-4 panes per fin bay); lower blocks at the base
cwb-0520.crown: set-back two-storey crown box with an open metal frame/cornice and "citi" signs on the faces
cwb-0520.setbacks: crown set back from the shaft; stepped lower wings
cwb-0520.night_lighting: illuminated citi logos on the crown

measurement.note: bay_m is the major fin spacing (5.0 and 5.4 m from two photos), derived from the assumed 4.44 m floor height (200/45, includes crown) and the metric aspect; low-medium confidence.

footprint_obb_m.note: oriented bounding box of the OSM outline (ODbL); used only as a scale for bay widths

cwb-0417.name: 8 Canada Square (HSBC Tower)
cwb-0417.cladding: about 4,900 glass panels; pale grey-green glass with alternating bands of vision glass and lighter opaque spandrel glass on every floor; fine vertical mullions about 1.5 m apart
cwb-0417.crown: flat top with plant behind a glazed band; HSBC lettering and red-and-white hexagon logo high on all four faces
cwb-0417.night_lighting: HSBC signs: black by day, lit white at night (LED polycarbonate since 2013-14)

measurement.check: bay 1.47 m from the west face width (59.4 m OSM / 40.5 mullion bays); 1.57-1.66 m from the assumed floor height. Measured floor height 3.92 m against 4.44 m assumed (200/45 includes crown and plant): -12%.
